comparison.objective: Candidate commissions and locks a robot-axis shock absorber through iterative physical impact tests. The record only names “merge into belt gap”; its body provides no task-objective description.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-key engagement, captive-setscrew loosening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, relocking, and physical cycle-control actuation. The record provides no manipulation-skill or mechanism details.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable, physically simulated stops within published energy, velocity, and 12 mm stroke limits, with no hard-stop strike, excessive rebound, overload, or setting drift. The record reports only “Dream-1 run: 0; demo: 1.0” and supplies no rubric or spec versions.
comparison.reason: The title suggests a different objective, but the complete available record has no specs and does not define what is merged, the physical interaction, or the scored outcome. Meaningful distinction cannot be established from title and score alone.
